settings.heading: Do you have a demo program?
settings.body:
We offer a 7-iron purchase program that lets you order a single iron in the model and specifications you want to test. If you decide to complete the set, we’ll invoice you for the remaining clubs with the 7-iron purchase applied.

Explore the 7-iron purchase program or email info@haywoodgolf.com for help.

settings.heading: Where can I get fit for Haywood clubs?
settings.body: View our current dealer and fitting partner list. We’re consistently adding locations, so check back for the nearest option.

settings.heading: What kind of customizations do you offer?
settings.body:
We can accommodate many custom requests, including coatings, stamping, engraving, etching, copper plating and torching. Customizations incur additional charges. Email info@haywoodgolf.com to discuss your project.

Our Instagram showcases past custom builds if you need inspiration.

settings.heading: Where are Haywood clubs manufactured?
settings.body: Haywood heads are manufactured at some of the same factories used by major equipment brands. Components are sourced directly from their manufacturers, and Haywood clubs are hand-assembled on demand in Vancouver, Canada.

settings.heading: Are the clubs eligible for returns?
settings.body: Eligibility depends on the product and whether it was customized. Please review our complete return, order and shipping policy before ordering.

settings.heading: What currency do you charge in?
settings.body: We operate one global site—haywoodgolf.com—and pricing automatically adjusts based on your location.
